verdict.rationale: Missive's marketing says teams can 'collaborate behind the scenes' on shared conversations (missive-docs-30, missive-docs-48), offers team chat (missive-docs-8) and real-time collaborative drafting and review (missive-docs-7), and has an Internal/External search filter that implies internal messages sit alongside email (missive-docs-4); a community user also prefers Missive for collaboration (missive-comm-3). However, nothing explicitly documents comments attached to a specific email thread or @mentions, so the core mechanism is only implied. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of in-conversation internal comments beside the message, @mention notifications, and hands-on corroboration of the side-thread workflow.
